decimation.why: The upstream workbook is 14.5 MB, which does not belong in a source repository. Every 60th sample is kept, giving a 1-minute grid. The only test this extract feeds is a departure-from-straight-line measurement over a multi-hour discharge, for which a 1-minute grid resolves the plateau and the knee with room to spare. The full workbook's SHA-256 is recorded in EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE.json so the reduction is checkable against the original.
